name: numpyro_parallel_s1
busy_cpus_note: average number of busy logical CPUs during the run, inside and outside the taskset list; work outside it is other work on the machine (CPUs 12-23 are the SMT siblings of 0-11, so it competes for the same cores)

extra.gradients_note: sampling iterations only (sum of num_steps over the kept draws); warmup not recorded
extra.compile_note: sum of JAX's reported trace, lowering and backend compile durations inside mcmc.run
extra.sampling_note: mcmc.run wall time minus the compile durations
extra.settings: NumPyro 0.22.0, JAX 0.11.2 CPU, x64; NUTS defaults (max_tree_depth 10, target_accept_prob 0.8, diagonal mass matrix); 4 chains, chain_method='parallel', 4 XLA host devices, 1000 warmup + 1000 draws
